name: Furnished room (integration, 100 ticks)
expected: At every tick where F becomes true while moving forward: left free -> Turn Left; left blocked and right free -> Turn Right; all three blocked -> Backward. Cleaning is clean_off during every turn and reverse.
Every turn lasts 3 ticks; a reverse lasts at least 3 ticks and continues while both sides are blocked, then turns (left first).
Dust while moving forward with clean_on starts a 3-tick clean_up; further dust does not restart it; an obstacle cancels it.
A side obstacle alone never changes the movement.
Direction / Clean are written only when they change.
function_text: EF-02 – Straight forward movement with normal cleaning (clean_on)
EF-06 – Avoidance: turn left, left has priority when both sides are free
EF-07 – Avoidance: turn right when the left is blocked
EF-10 – Boxed in (F, L, R): move backward for at least 3 ticks, continue while both sides are blocked
EF-11 – Reverse ends with a turn, left first
EF-12 – Dust: power-up (clean_up) for 3 ticks, then back to clean_on
EF-14 – An obstacle during power-up cancels the power-up
EF-09 – Cleaning stopped (clean_off) only while turning or reversing
